Let <MATH_0001> be a topological space.
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> Epimorphisms (resp.<SPACE_0001>monomorphisms) in the category of
presheaves are exactly the surjective (resp.<SPACE_0002>injective) maps
of presheaves.
<STRUCT_0003> Epimorphisms (resp.<SPACE_0003>monomorphisms) in the category of
sheaves are exactly the surjective (resp.<SPACE_0004>injective) maps
of sheaves, and are exactly those maps which are surjective
(resp.<SPACE_0005>injective) on all the stalks.
<STRUCT_0004> The sheafification of a surjective (resp.<SPACE_0006>injective)
morphism of presheaves of sets is surjective (resp.<SPACE_0007>injective).
<STRUCT_0005>
